0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks host the Los Angeles Lakers in their 12th game of the season, and the Hawks come in at 7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East, with a four-game win streak and a 6-4 record over their last ten. The Lakers are 8-2, first in the Pacific and third in the West, on a four-game win streak and an 8-2 mark over their last ten. Atlanta is without Asa Newell, Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale, Keshon Gilbert and Mouhamed Gueye, while the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, with the Hawks' last meeting a 141-116 loss in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
